theme.rationale: Australian educational, government (Workforce Australia/TtW/DES), and vocational training services require maximum readability, institutional trust, and high-contrast WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility for diverse users and lower digital literacy participants. Crisp light theme with rich eucalyptus green, deep navy slate, and warm ochre accents conveys approachable public-sector authority without sterility.

rules: All normal text has minimum 4.5:1 contrast against surface background.
All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, checkboxes) have visible focus rings with `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-teal-600 focus-visible:ring-offset-2`.
Clear visual indicators for Australian Points-Based Activation System (PBAS) requirements with accessible color + icon pairings (never color alone).
All icons have aria-hidden='true' when paired with text, or aria-label when icon-only.
Mandatory data-testid on every interactive button, input, modal trigger, role-switch, quiz answer, and export button.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the Australian English terminology throughout: 'Jobseeker', 'Resume' (not CV), 'Case Manager', 'Mutual Obligation', 'Points-Based Activation System (PBAS)', 'Transition to Work (TtW)', 'Disability Employment Services (DES)'.

The AI Interview Simulator must feature multi-turn Australian industry interview questions (5 realistic questions: Retail, Hospitality, Warehousing, Admin, Entry Trades) with dynamic scoring against Australian Core Skills for Work (Communication, Problem Solving, Workplace Etiquette) and exportable PDF/Printable scorecard.
The PBAS Job Search Logger must track points (e.g. 5 points per direct application, 10 points for interview attended, target 100 points/month) with evidence upload mock and confirmation badges.

Include rich pre-seeded modules (Digital Literacy in the Workplace, Australian Workplace Rights & Safety, First Impressions & Behavioural Interviews, Written Communication for Job Search) with interactive MCQ quiz and certificate generator upon 80%+ pass.
Case Manager/Coach view must feature search, filtering by risk/PBAS compliance status, inline private case notes, and single-click CSV/PDF compliance report export.
Provider Admin view must include Recharts graphs for cohort completion rates, module engagement, and tenant branding settings (School, TtW, DES, Workforce Australia).

Ensure all interactive buttons, inputs, links, and cards have explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. `data-testid='start-interview-button'`, `data-testid='pbas-submit-button'`, `data-testid='role-switch-coach'`).
